theorems.name: Submission.idtp_dema_density_on_carrier
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → R.measure K ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)), x ∈ R.carrier → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => R.measure (ball x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
